node.title: counting words in string
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hi perlmonks, nice to meet you. I am practicing my regexes and want to know how many times a word in a string occurs but i am not succeeding. However i did wrote a working example but not by using a regex. Here it is:

use strict; use warnings; my %hash=(); my $re = "iowq john stepy andy anne alic bert stepy anne bert andy step alic andy"; my @names = split(/\s+/,$re); foreach(@names) { $hash{$_}++; } foreach(keys %hash) { print "key: $_ value: $hash{$_} \n"; }

Can someone show me a regex to do all this?
